pooled_caveat: The heterogeneous cluster mixes retrospective records, causal claims, aspirations, and policy models; it should not be read as one coherent theory within or across groups.
pooled_summary: Historical claims explain prosperity, growth, jobs, and poverty reduction through competing models: public investment, education, inclusion, markets, trade, tax and regulatory policy, resource development, or socialist alternatives. Many examples are narratives about economic outcomes rather than discrete program commitments.
qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of period- and document-diverse central examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.
title: Economic Prosperity Narratives and Development Models
